clips.title: 扎克伯格低价AIAPI，Meta云业务能否突围？

subtitles.en: CEO Mark Zuckerberg told Bloomberg News that Spark 1.1 includes a new paid tier for developers.
subtitles.zh: CEO马克·扎克伯格告诉彭博新闻，Spark 1.1为开发者新增了付费层级。

subtitles.en: Well, let's get more on this now with Bloomberg's Kurt Wagner, who spoke with Zuckerberg.
subtitles.zh: 下面有请彭博社的库尔特·瓦格纳，他与扎克伯格进行了对话。

subtitles.en: Kurt, give us some of the finer details. What did Mark tell you?
subtitles.zh: 库尔特，请分享一些细节。马克跟你说了什么？

subtitles.en: Yeah, I mean, this is a model that is an updated Muse Spark. Muse Spark was already out. This is Muse Spark 1.1, as you mentioned.
subtitles.zh: 是的，这是Muse Spark的更新版本。Muse Spark已经发布，这是Muse Spark 1.1。

subtitles.en: But I think the big thing here is that for the very first time, they're going to sell access to this model to businesses and developers. They have that API
subtitles.zh: 但重要的是，他们首次向企业和开发者出售该模型的访问权限，提供了API。

subtitles.en: that we've sort of been waiting for, that a lot of the other AI companies already offer.
subtitles.zh: 我们一直在等待这个API，许多其他AI公司已经提供了。

subtitles.en: And so this is a direct revenue stream for them. And one of the things that we spent a lot of time talking about when I chatted with Zuckerberg was the pricing. And the fact that he really wants
subtitles.zh: 这成为他们的直接收入来源。我与扎克伯格交谈时，花了很多时间讨论定价。

subtitles.en: to go cheap on the pricing. One, because he thinks the competitors are too expensive.
subtitles.zh: 他确实希望定价低廉。一是因为他认为竞争对手太贵。

subtitles.en: Two, because he's trying to get this model into as many hands as possible.
subtitles.zh: 二是因为他试图让尽可能多的人使用这个模型。

subtitles.en: And the cheaper he does that, the cheaper he makes, excuse the more likely that is to happen.
subtitles.zh: 定价越低，越有可能实现这一目标。

subtitles.en: So this is very much a classic meta strategy. Make things as cheap as possible for as much distribution as possible.
subtitles.zh: 这非常符合Meta的经典策略：尽可能降低成本，实现最大范围的覆盖。

subtitles.en: So on one hand, they have this new way of generating revenue with this AI model.
subtitles.zh: 一方面，他们通过这个AI模型开辟了新的收入来源。

subtitles.en: And Kurt, you and the team also learning earlier in the month that they're also now setting up a cloud business to sell AI compute. How much of this is just trying to escape this
subtitles.zh: Kurt，你和团队在本月初还了解到，他们正在建立云业务来销售AI算力。这在多大程度上是为了摆脱Meta当前的困境？

subtitles.en: trap that meta is and with it shares now into a bear market about, can you get a return on investment that all the meta, all the spending and catbacks that meta is currently undergoing?
subtitles.zh: 随着Meta股价进入熊市，其所有资本支出能否获得回报？
